Simulate a Farm Configuration

Source: R/farm.R
simulate_farm.Rd

Creates a farm-level configuration object that defines the context for all downstream simulations. Acts as the entry point for the VirtualDairyHerdR simulation pipeline.

Usage

simulate_farm(
  name = "Virtual Farm",
  location = "Ireland",
  system = c("grass-based", "housed", "mixed"),
  n_cows = 100,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

name

Character. Farm name. Default is "Virtual Farm".

location

Character. Country or region. Default is "Ireland".

system

Character. Production system: "grass-based", "housed", or "mixed". Default is "grass-based".

n_cows

Integer. Target herd size. Default is 100.

seed

Integer. Random seed for reproducibility. Default is NULL.

Value

A named list with farm configuration parameters and metadata.

Examples

farm <- simulate_farm(name = "Greenfield Farm", n_cows = 200, seed = 42)
